meta.title: JEE coaching fees in Pune, and batch dates | D-SAP
meta.description: Fees and batch dates for our JEE programmes in Pune, what the fee includes, and when the next batches start at New Sangvi and Wakad.

intro: Fees and start dates for each programme, with what the fee covers. If anything here is unclear, call us on {{fact:contact.phone}}.

body.text: The fee covers all of this:

points.text: Study material for the whole syllabus, with past IIT JEE papers solved.
Every test on the online portal, each with a personal analysis.
The doubts forum and doubt sessions.
Online lectures, for any class your child misses.

a.text: The two-year programme starts in June, with a foundation period from April.
